name: Create recurring invoice
description:
## POST /api/v1/recurring_invoices

Adds a Recurring Invoice to the system
whenToUse: Create a new recurring invoice from client, dates, frequency, and line items; use to set up recurring billing (mutating).

queryParameters.name: include
queryParameters.description: Includes child relationships in the response, format is comma separated. Check each model for the list of associated includes

fields.name: client_id
fields.description: The hashed ID of the client

fields.name: due_date
fields.description: Due date for the recurring invoice

fields.name: private_notes
fields.description: Private notes for the recurring invoice

fields.name: public_notes
fields.description: Public notes for the recurring invoice

fields.name: line_items
fields.description: An array of objects which define the line items of the invoice
